sources.snippet: A: The large model provides better character accuracy and handles challenging handwriting more reliably, while the small version trades accuracy for faster inference speed and lower memory usage. Choose based on whether your application prioritizes speed (small) or accuracy (large). Q: Does this model work on printed text or only handwritten text?

sources.snippet: TrOCR-large-handwritten is a Microsoft-developed multimodal model based on the Vision-Encoder-Decoder architecture, specialized in converting handwritten images to text with excellent performance on complex handwriting, suitable for digital archive organization and automatic form entry.

sources.title: microsoft/trocr-large-handwritten - AI Model Zoo - BimAnt
sources.snippet: TrOCR model fine-tuned on the IAM dataset. It was introduced in the paper TrOCR: Transformer-based Optical Character Recognition with Pre-trained Models by Li et al. and first released in this repository. Disclaimer: The team releasing TrOCR did not write a model card for this model so this model card has been written by the Hugging Face team.
